components.heading: Kame House Environment Study
paragraphs: Kame House is a real-time environment study built around a recognizable silhouette and a deliberately compact scene. The goal was to translate a stylized animated location into a dimensional space while preserving its bright, graphic identity.
The work moves from a value-focused greyscale pass into final materials, atmosphere, water, vegetation, lighting, and cinematic framing.
Comparing the process and final renders shows how composition and light carry the scene as much as the modeled architecture.

components.title: Color, atmosphere, and foliage complete the read.

components.caption: The final scene balances the house silhouette against water, sky, and island vegetation.

components.quote: “The environment was built to read first as a silhouette, then as a place.”
